correctness.rationale: Write eta_i=1-epsilon u_i, u_i>=0, sum_i u_i=1. The simple 2 eigenvalue of adjacency K makes its perturbed Perron root F(epsilon,u) uniformly C^2 in u for small epsilon across the compact simplex. With J=11^T/5 and reduced resolvent R=(2I-K+J)^-1-J, exact second coefficient Q(u)=(2/5)u^T R K u=(4/25)(E(u)-N(u)), where E=sum cycle-edge products and N=sum two-step nonedge products. An exact Motzkin-Straus-type support shifting proves E<=1/4, and Q=1/25 only at the five balanced adjacent-edge vectors v=(e_i+e_{i+1})/2, because equality also requires N=0. Uniform C^2 convergence of (F-2+2epsilon/5)/epsilon^2 to Q forces every global maximizer near these isolated points. At any v, Q inactive-coordinate partial derivatives are strictly smaller than active ones; the strict inequality persists and forces the optimizer onto the corresponding edge face. Strict negative second derivative -8/25 on that face persists, and reflection symmetry forces the unique exact edge optimum to equal split. Independently reconstructed the 5x5 Q matrix with adjacent coefficients 2/25 and nonadjacent -2/25, characteristic polynomial factors for single and adjacent allocation, and sample Perron roots. Universal small-epsilon proof uses compactness and analytic eigenvalue perturbation, not sampled epsilon values.

originality.rationale: Delmas, Dronnier and Zitt (2023) introduce exactly the cycle next-generation model and anti-Pareto vaccination; their Section 2.4 gives an extinction-cost theorem and N=12 numerical Pareto/anti-Pareto heuristics, not the exact N=5 small-budget maximizer. Their 2022 cordon sanitaire theorem excludes disconnecting strategies as worst, but all candidate eta_i here stay strictly positive and connected. The separate convexity/concavity sufficient cases do not apply to the mixed-sign spectrum of C5. Thus the explicit N=5 adjacent equal-split phase is not implied by these strong prior results.
residual_risks: The small-budget cutoff epsilon0 is proved existentially, not given numerically or shown maximal.
The original N=12 anti-Pareto plots suggest a different first strategy; this is not a contradiction because graph order changes, but broader all-cycle structure remains unexplored.
Other nonindexed small-graph optimization results could exist, but inspected same-model primary papers do not cover C5.

value.rationale: A motivated sharp local optimization theorem for the smallest unresolved odd epidemic circle determines ALL worst vaccine allocations, not merely an example or simulated approximate strategy. The exact adjacent equal split reverses an intuitive one-group-first heuristic at N=5 and supplies a controlled spectral perturbation benchmark within the stated idealized model.

final_claim: For the undirected five-cycle next-generation adjacency matrix, uniform exact vaccine cost epsilon/5 and eta_i in [0,1], there exists epsilon0>0 such that for every 0<epsilon<epsilon0 the only residual-transmission maximizing allocations are the five cyclic rotations of eta=(1-epsilon/2,1-epsilon/2,1,1,1). The maximum is 2-(2/5)epsilon+(1/25)epsilon^2+O(epsilon^3), strictly above the single-vertex allocation.
limitations: Only N=5 equal groups, unit-weight undirected cycle, perfect vaccination, exact uniform cost and sufficiently small positive budget.
No numeric largest epsilon0 and no statement for medium/large budgets or nonlinear epidemiological trajectories.
